Data:N.debt.continue.json.label: The Debt Forgiven?
Data:N.debt.continue.json.desc: Whatever the Reckoners of Kaunas did or knew, we've turned our faces from it.

Data:N.debt.democratise.json.label: The Wangle of the Crowd
Data:N.debt.democratise.json.desc: The solemnly named 'Wangle', by which mortals might win extra years of life despite the Madrugad's limits, has been quietly reproduced, and the technique promulgated underground by Arun Peel and his co-conspirators. This will be a source of quiet chaos.

Data:N.debt.json.label: The Forgivable Debt
Data:N.debt.json.desc: The Reckoners of Kaunas still prosecute their underworld war against each other. The cause - and this is an increasingly badly kept secret - is that the balance of power has been upset… by a way to cheat additional years from the Hour named Madrugad.

Data:N.debt.profit.json.label: A Profitable Wangle
Data:N.debt.profit.json.desc: Azita Bukhara has learnt the secret of the 'Wangle', the feit by which mortals might win extra years of life despite the Madrugad's limits. She expects to profit greatly from it.

Data:N.endeavour.concluded.json.label: The Royal Endeavour, Concluded
Data:N.endeavour.concluded.json.desc: Whatever the New King is up to, we have no further interest in it.

Data:N.endeavour.json.label: The Royal Endeavour
Data:N.endeavour.json.desc: What lies at the heart of the New King's great project?

Data:N.endeavour.protected.json.label: The Royal Endeavour, Protected
Data:N.endeavour.protected.json.desc: The Endeavour-name Fissifer has been protected. The Royal Endeavour proceeds on schedule.

Data:N.endeavour.revealed.json.label: The Royal Endeavour, Revealed
Data:N.endeavour.revealed.json.desc: The Endeavour-name Fissifer is badly wounded - and the nature of the New King's project has been laid bare for those with eyes to see.

Data:N.endeavour.sabotaged.json.label: The Royal Endeavour: Sabotaged!
Data:N.endeavour.sabotaged.json.desc: The Endeavour-name Fissifer is badly wounded - and a fragment of him has been passed to a Continental power.

Data:N.eye.betray.json.label: Eyeless among Fires
Data:N.eye.betray.json.desc: Lucia the Eyeless will parley with the Chandler. Perhaps she'll alter her loyalties; perhaps the Chandler will free poor Ghirbi. There will be changes. But surely the Chancel will not be compromised?

Data:N.eye.independent.json.label: Eyeless and Unfettered
Data:N.eye.independent.json.desc: Lucia the Eyeless might work to free poor Ghirbi - even if that tests her loyalties to the Meniscate.

Data:N.eye.json.label: The Unfettered Eye
Data:N.eye.json.desc: What is behind the manifestations in Messana?

Data:N.eye.loyal.json.label: Eyeless and Loyal
Data:N.eye.loyal.json.desc: Lucia the Eyeless will remain a loyal Name of the Meniscate, despite her disquiet over the treatment of her fellow name, Ghirbi.

Data:N.eye.revealed.json.label: Eyeless in Messana
Data:N.eye.revealed.json.desc: Lucia the Eyeless, name of the Meniscate, has taken to gifting mortals with sight - even though that may not be the wish of the Meniscate.

Data:N.grunewald.chrysalis.json.label: The Grunewald Rebirth
Data:N.grunewald.chrysalis.json.desc: The 'refugee' from the Grunewald Permanent Circus has has been assimilated into the chrysalis in the old prison. Good?

Data:N.grunewald.concluded.json.label: The Grunewald Conclusion
Data:N.grunewald.concluded.json.desc: No news is good news. The matter is at an end as far as we're concerned.

Data:N.grunewald.crucible.json.label: The Grunewald Eradication
Data:N.grunewald.crucible.json.desc: The 'refugee' from the Grunewald Permanent Circus has been destroyed in the crucible at Hush House. It's probably for the best.

Data:N.grunewald.json.label: The Grunewald Provision
Data:N.grunewald.json.desc: How's it going with the 'malignities' from the Grunewald business?

Data:N.grunewald.wisp.json.label: The Grunewald Remnant
Data:N.grunewald.wisp.json.desc: A visitor brought a 'refugee' from the remains of the Grunewald Permanent Circus, insisting it's not dangerous.

Data:N.guest.closed.json.label: The End of the Guest
Data:N.guest.closed.json.desc: 'An inhabitation of Worms' is too unpleasant an idea to take any kind of risk. I refused Spencer Hobson entry to Hush House. He did not defy me, and now he is gone; perhaps gone from the Histories.

Data:N.guest.concluded.json.label: Less of the Guest
Data:N.guest.concluded.json.desc: Hush House will have nothing to do with Spencer Hobson. 'An inhabitation of Worms' is too unpleasant an idea to take any kind of risk.

Data:N.guest.hobson.json.label: Hobson's Choice
Data:N.guest.hobson.json.desc: Spencer Hobson is due to arrive in Brancrug at Numa.

Data:N.guest.json.label: The Endless Guest
Data:N.guest.json.desc: What happened to Spencer Hobson, the Bureau employee who regarded his 'inhabitation of Worms' as a guest?

Data:N.guest.upgraded.json.label: The Guest's gift.
Data:N.guest.upgraded.json.desc: Hobson has entered the Rowenarium and will not be seen again. The Rowenarium has found its next phase.

Data:N.heist.concealed.json.label: Dagmar's Secret Kept
Data:N.heist.concealed.json.desc: The perpetrator of the Oriflamme Heist was Dagmar von Nagelsburg… but her secret is safe.

Data:N.heist.concluded.json.label: The Oriflamme Heist, Concluded
Data:N.heist.concluded.json.desc: What actually happened at Oriflamme's? We'll never know.

Data:N.heist.exposed.json.label: Dagmar's Secret Exposed
Data:N.heist.exposed.json.desc: The perpetrator of the Oriflamme Heist was Dagmar von Nagelsburg… and now that Oriflamme's knows that, she'll be in trouble.

Data:N.heist.investigated.json.label: The Oriflamme Heist, Investigated
Data:N.heist.investigated.json.desc: The perpetrator of the Oriflamme Heist was Dagmar von Nagelsburg. I could inform on her to Oriflamme's, probably for a reward. I could promise her my silence, winning her loyalty to the Institute. Or I could forget the matter.

Data:N.heist.json.label: The Oriflamme Heist
Data:N.heist.json.desc: What actually happened at Oriflamme's? A heist? A forgery? A fraud? Nothing at all?

Data:N.horizon.concluded.json.label: Another Horizon
Data:N.horizon.concluded.json.desc: Whatever happened with the prowling emissary of Ys is best forgotten.

Data:N.horizon.deported.json.label: Lost Horizon
Data:N.horizon.deported.json.desc: The prowling emissary of Ys was returned to his home beyond the wave.

Data:N.horizon.json.label: The Other Horizon
Data:N.horizon.json.desc: Is an emissary of Ys really abroad in the Bounds?

Data:N.horizon.met.dagmar.json.label: Dagmar and the Horizon
Data:N.horizon.met.dagmar.json.desc: Dagmar has met with the emissary of Ys. Perhaps, some day, she'll satisfy her ambition to visit the place…

Data:N.invisible.alteration.json.label: An Invisible Alteration
Data:N.invisible.alteration.json.desc: The democratisation of the Wangle has made it possible to loosen Calyptra's grip. This could end very messily.

Data:N.invisible.arrangement.json.label: An Invisible Arrangement
Data:N.invisible.arrangement.json.desc: A fragile arrangement with the merchants of years has loosened Calyptra's grip, a little.

Data:N.invisible.concluded.json.label: An Invisible Conclusion
Data:N.invisible.concluded.json.desc: Whatever happened in Venice will remain in Venice.

Data:N.invisible.corrivality.json.label: An Invisible Intrigue
Data:N.invisible.corrivality.json.desc: The business in Venice was the beginning of a serious disagreement between Madrugad and Moth - and their respective allies. This could be the beginning of something cataclysmic.

Data:N.invisible.failed.json.label: An Invisible Debacle
Data:N.invisible.failed.json.desc: The performance of the 'Invisible Opera' in Venice ended prematurely with a fire backstage and a murder in the ticket office. This is is the sort of thing that usually happens. But this time, also, a handful of audience members  are haunted now by dreams of black-and-white flowers - whose perfume follows them into the waking world...

Data:N.invisible.json.label: The Invisible Opera
Data:N.invisible.json.desc: Someone unwisely attempted a performance of the Moth-haunted 'Invisible Opera' in Venice. What happened?

Data:N.invisible.salvaged.json.label: An Invisible Salvation
Data:N.invisible.salvaged.json.desc: The performance of the 'Invisible Opera' in Venice was successfully completed, with no known fatalities: a historical first. Even the notices were not uniformly terrible, despite the lighting difficulties that plunged the third act into darkness. But a handful of audience members are haunted now by dreams of black-and-white flowers - whose perfume follows them into the waking world...
